music_profile.meter: Variable multi-meter cycles determined by varṇakāla (4 to 68 units)
music_profile.musical_form: Prabandha-giti (comprising up to 6 angas: svara, viruda, pada, tenaka, pata, tala)

music_profile.sound_description: The soundscape of Gaudiya Nritya is characterized by resonant, complex drumming from the Pakhavaj and Shrikhol supporting classical devotional singing. Verses follow classical ragas and structured Prabandha-giti forms like Kirtana, built over precise rhythmic metric cycles.
music_profile.vocal_style: Devotional classical singing including Kirtana and Bhavasangita
